conviction_note: The Q3 numbers are new (no trading update since the H1 report), so the move is sized on the new-numbers scale and a possible guide change. But the evidence on direction cancels out. The company's 2026 habit of pre-releasing material deviations (20 Feb, 10 Jul) and its silence since then point to an in-line quarter. The unchanged guide implies a very conservative H2 organic pace, which the single analyst already models above the top of the guide. So p_up is 50 and the signed number is 0, while abs_move stays at 5.5.

findings.finding: SP Group has published no Q3 trading update or profit warning since the H1 report. In 2026 it used inside-information trading updates both times its results moved away from market expectations (FY2025 on 20 Feb, Q2 on 10 Jul). The silence suggests Q3 is not far from expectations, which points to an unchanged or narrowed guide, and that would sit under the sole analyst's FY revenue of 3,868m, already above the 3,833m guide top.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Pre-released surprises moved the stock +7.35% (20 Feb 2026 FY25 trading update) and +8.77% (10 Jul 2026 Q2 trading update). The last scheduled reports without a pre-release moved -2.03% (Q3 2025, 18 Nov 2025) and +4.34% (Q1 2026, 29 Apr 2026). The H1 report, already pre-released, moved 0.0% (20 Aug 2026). Moves computed from the Yahoo SPG.CO daily closes
findings.original_quote: SP Group A/S har genereret større salg og indtjening end forventet i 2. kvartal 2026 (Danish version of the 10 Jul trading update, https://mfn.se/ind/a/sp-group/trading-update-for-2-kvartal-og-1-halvar-2026-8239cb14 : 'SP Group A/S has generated higher sales and earnings than expected in Q2 2026')
findings.why_not_priced: Only one analyst covers the stock and the turnover is about $0.5m a day. The 3,868m FY estimate published on 12 Oct sits above the guide, so the only visible bar assumes a raise the company has not signalled. If the market had read the silence, the published estimate would have been trimmed to within the guide. It is an inference from an absence, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: The FY2025 trading update was also issued as inside information, and it was in line with guidance ('Results are in line with the most recently announced guidance'). That shows the company pre-releases when a result departs from the market's view: https://www.inderes.se/en/releases/trading-update-for-fy-2025-preliminary-and-unaudited-figures

findings.finding: Unchanged guidance implies a sharp H2 slowdown in organic growth. The company says acquisitions are 16-17 points of the 24-30% growth, so organic growth is 8-13% for the year, or DKK 236-383m on the FY2025 base of 2,948m. H1 already delivered about DKK 289m of organic growth (19.7% of 1,466.9m). That leaves H2 organic at roughly -3.6% to +6.3%, against Q2's +29.4% and a weak Q3 2025 comparison (about DKK 655m). This leaves room for a Q3 beat or a guide raise.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance raises in 2026 came with +8.77% (10 Jul trading update) and +3.23% (19 Aug OGM deal and acquisition-driven raise). Moves computed from the Yahoo SPG.CO daily closes
findings.original_quote: Revenue growth of 24–30% is now expected, corresponding to revenue of DKK 3.6–3.8 billion, with acquisitions accounting for 16–17% of the growth. (Danish version: 'Der forventes nu en omsætningsvækst på 24–30%' in the delårsrapport, https://mfn.se/ind/a/sp-group/sp-groups-delarsrapport-for-1-halvar-2026-0fb64786)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced already: the sole analyst's FY 3,868m and Q3 908m (about +39% year on year) model above-guide revenue. The stock is -5.2% over 60 days and -1.3% over 20 days, from 480 after H1 to 457.5, so the market is not pricing an aggressive raise. Kept small because the bar already holds most of it and finding 1 argues against a pre-signalled beat.

lessons_applied: abs_move_pct raised from 4.5 to 5.5. The lessons say the move lives in the guide (9.0% median on a change, 2.3% on a reiteration), the Q3 numbers are not pre-released (7.4% base), and hunters' moves ran about three times too small. The no-pre-release evidence holds it below 7. The finding sizes and p_up are unchanged.
